// diagnostic

E0442

This `if` table header calls `{name}`, which has an effect

What

This `if` table header calls `{name}`, which has an effect

Why

A hole table runs its header once for each arm it tries, so the effect of `{name}` would run again for every arm

Fix

Name the value first: `value: {name}(…)` on the line above, then read `value` in the header

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0442: Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_header_effect.stderr.

Error [jet.HoleHeaderEffect]: This `if` table header calls `noisy`, which has an effect
  --> Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_header_effect.jet:9:8
    |
  9 |     if noisy(n) % <> == 0 {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: A hole table runs its header once for each arm it tries, so the effect of `noisy` would run again for every arm
 Fix: Name the value first: `value: noisy(…)` on the line above, then read `value` in the header
